desc: Derive the exact greedy algorithm by simulating on sample 3 ([1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1]) to achieve 8 operations, and identify the pattern (e.g., using a set of "active" values scanned left to right).
Implement the solution in Python with O(N) per test case, handling T up to 1e5 and total N up to 2e5.
Test the implementation on the sample inputs to verify correctness.
Optimize for performance (e.g., fast I/O) and ensure it fits within constraints.
